title: Tech S And T Cloud Dev-AI Product Engineer-NGTO-Senior-GDSF02
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Technical AI Product Engineer**
 4–7 Years \| Full\-time
   

  

 If you want to move beyond experiments and build AI systems that truly power products and decisions—this role is for you.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are building next\-generation AI\-powered products and platforms that transform how businesses operate, make decisions, and engage with customers.
   

  

 As a Technical AI Product Engineer, you will design and deliver production\-grade GenAI and Agentic AI solutions—owning the full lifecycle from problem framing to deployment and continuous optimization.
   

  

 This role is ideal for engineers who combine deep AI/ML expertise with strong engineering rigor and product thinking, and want to build scalable, measurable, and responsible AI systems in a real\-world enterprise setting.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
**Build AI Products, Not Just Models**
* Design and develop GenAI\-powered applications using LLMs, RAG, and agentic workflows
* Translate business problems into measurable AI\-driven outcomes
* Define evaluation metrics and product success criteria


**Engineer Intelligent Systems at Scale**
* Build and optimize retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines
* Develop agent\-based AI systems with tool usage and orchestration
* Deploy solutions on cloud\-native architectures (Azure preferred)


**Own the AI Lifecycle (GenAI Ops)**
* Implement prompt engineering strategies, embeddings, and fine\-tuning approaches
* Build evaluation frameworks and guardrails for reliability and safety
* Enable continuous monitoring of quality, latency, and cost


**Drive Responsible \& Secure AI**
* Embed responsible AI practices (bias detection, explainability, moderation)
* Ensure data privacy, governance, and compliance standards
* Build systems aligned with enterprise security and trust principles


**Collaborate \& influence**
* Partner with product, data, and engineering teams to prioritize AI features
* Influence enterprise AI architecture and best practices
* Enable teams through reusable AI components and APIs


**What You Bring**
**Must\-Have Skills**
* Strong programming in Python and SQL
* Hands\-on experience with GenAI patterns: Prompt engineering, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), Embeddings \& semantic search, Agentic workflows
* Experience with AI/ML frameworks: PyTorch / TensorFlow, Hugging Face, LangChain / Semantic Kernel
* Experience deploying AI solutions on cloud platforms (Azure preferred): Azure OpenAI, Azure ML , Azure AI Search


**Engineering \& Platform Skills**
* Strong foundation in data processing (Pandas, NumPy, Spark/Databricks)
* Experience with MLOps / GenAI Ops: MLflow, pipelines, CI/CD, Docker, Azure DevOps
* Experience building APIs and integrating AI into applications
* Understanding of monitoring, observability, and system reliability


**Good\-to\-Have**
* Experience building agent\-based or autonomous AI systems
* Cost optimization for LLM workloads
* Multi\-modal AI (text, image, voice)
* Frontend integration for AI\-driven experiences


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, AI/ Data Engineering, or related field
* 2\+ years of experience in AI engineering or development


**Additional**
* Certifications in AI, genAI or Ganetic AI
* Experience with data governance, security, and compliance standards


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: SCT_Tech Enablement_AI Architect_Manager
description:

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 AI Architect\- SC products: We are seeking an experienced Supply Chain AI Solution Architect to join our Digital Supply Chain Team. This hybrid role combines enterprise AI architecture, Supply Chain taxonomies and knowledge graph, product thinking, and client advisory to translate business needs into secure, scalable solutions that deliver measurable value.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, product owners, and technical teams to identify AI opportunities and translate requirements into scalable AI solution architectures.
* Design and architect enterprise\-grade AI applications leveraging LLMs, RAG, Agentic AI, Knowledge Graphs, GraphRAG, and Multimodal AI patterns.
* Define end\-to\-end AI solution architectures, including model selection, data retrieval strategy, orchestration frameworks, deployment models, and integration patterns.
* Design and implement advanced prompting, context engineering, structured outputs, tool calling, workflow orchestration, and memory management strategies.
* Architect hybrid retrieval solutions using vector search, semantic search, GraphRAG, SQL\-based retrieval, and vectorless approaches.
* Design and implement MCP\-based integrations with enterprise applications, APIs, databases, and business systems.
* Establish AI platform standards covering observability, evaluation frameworks, LLMOps, monitoring, governance, performance optimization, and cost management.
* Define AI security architectures addressing prompt injection, data leakage, unauthorized tool access, jailbreak attempts, and AI\-specific threats.
* Ensure compliance with Responsible AI principles, privacy regulations, governance requirements, and security standards.
* Conduct architecture reviews, technical assessments, proof\-of\-concepts, and production\-readiness evaluations.
* Drive AI adoption across business and technology teams through workshops, technical leadership, and stakeholder engagement.
* Mentor AI engineers, architects, and developers while defining best practices, reusable frameworks, and reference architectures.
* Stay current with emerging AI technologies, frameworks, and industry trends to drive continuous innovation.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* 12\+ years of experience in software engineering, cloud architecture, data engineering, enterprise architecture, or related technology domains.
* Strong experience designing and implementing enterprise AI, Generative AI, and intelligent automation solutions.
* Hands\-on experience with Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, context engineering, RAG, embeddings, reranking, and vector databases.
* Strong knowledge of AI agent architectures, multi\-agent systems, tool calling, memory strategies, and human\-in\-the\-loop workflows.
* Proficiency in Python, API development, microservices architecture, and distributed systems.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform and their AI services.
* Strong understanding of databases, data platforms, event\-driven architectures, and enterprise integration patterns.
* Practical experience with MCP, REST APIs, JSON\-RPC, OAuth, and secure integration frameworks.
* Knowledge of AI evaluation frameworks, tracing, monitoring, observability, LLMOps, and AI cost optimization.
* Understanding of model fine\-tuning, LoRA/QLoRA, model routing, quantization, and inference optimization techniques.
* Experience with multimodal AI, knowledge graphs, GraphRAG, SQL agents, and advanced retrieval architectures.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, architecture documentation, and leadership skills.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities with a focus on delivering business outcomes.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Experience with frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, CrewAI, or equivalent orchestration platforms.
* Experience working with OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, Azure AI, AWS Bedrock, Hugging Face, or similar AI ecosystems.
* Familiarity with vector databases and search platforms such as Pinecone, Qdrant, Weaviate, Milvus, pgvector, Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, or Neo4j.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, MLflow, vLLM, Langfuse, Ragas, DeepEval, and AI platform engineering practices.
* Understanding of AI governance and security frameworks, including NIST AI RMF, OWASP GenAI Security, ISO/IEC 42001, and cloud security best practices.
* Experience leading enterprise AI transformation initiatives, Centers of Excellence (CoE), or AI capability building programs.
* Exposure to MLOps, DataOps, and enterprise deployment strategies for scalable AI solutions.
* Experience engaging with executive stakeholders and presenting architecture roadmaps, AI strategies, and business cases.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
   

  

 Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
   

  

 To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
   

  

**Our Commitment:** 
 As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
   

  

**Professional Development:** 
 From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
   

  

**People and Culture:** 
 In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
   

  

**Benefits:** 
 Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
   

  

**How to Apply:** 
 If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.

title: Senior C++ 3D Vision & Digital Twin Engineer
description:
**Company Description** 
 Synergic Softek Solutions Pvt. Ltd. is an ISO 9001:2015 certified company that delivers a dynamic blend of strategy consulting and system integration services to help organizations build and scale their businesses. The company focuses on diversified software solutions across multiple sectors of the Indian economy, providing practical and efficient information system offerings. Synergic Softek Solutions emphasizes accessible, easy\-to\-implement solutions tailored to varied organizational needs. Team members work in an environment that values innovation, technical excellence, and collaboration.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Senior C\+\+ 3D Vision \& Digital Twin Engineer is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Kolkata. This role involves designing and implementing high\-performance C\+\+ applications for 3D vision, simulation, and digital twin environments, including real\-time data processing, rendering, and system integration. Responsibilities include developing architecture for digital twin platforms, optimizing algorithms for 3D data, collaborating with electronics and software teams to interface hardware and simulation systems, and ensuring robust integration with existing enterprise software. The engineer will participate in code reviews, performance tuning, documentation, and cross\-functional collaboration to deliver reliable and scalable solutions aligned with client requirements.
 



**Qualifications** 



* Strong software development skills with expertise in C\+\+ and experience in building high\-performance, real\-time systems.
* Solid foundation in programming concepts, algorithms, and data structures, with experience in 3D vision, graphics, or simulation frameworks.
* Understanding of electronics and hardware\-software interaction, enabling effective collaboration with embedded and hardware teams.
* Experience with integration of complex systems, including APIs, middleware, and interoperability between simulation/digital twin platforms and enterprise applications.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electronics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Strong problem\-solving skills, ability to work on\-site in a collaborative team, and clear written and verbal communication skills.

title: FS-RC-Actuarial-MG-ALFA-Integrate deployment-Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Role Name And Description**
 Senior, MG\-ALFA/Integrate user, tester or modeler, Life Actuarial, EY GDS Consulting
   

  

 Be part of a high\-performing, supportive culture
   

  

 Work with a team of collaborators, innovators and the brightest minds in the industry
   

  

 Global Delivery Services is one of EY's greatest global assets – a network of service delivery centers that provide high\-quality services at a competitive cost for all EY’s client serving and enablement teams. Every day, we combine our subject matter expertise with our technology and automation skills to develop new solutions that deliver greater value for EY. If you have a passion for enabling world class actuarial services globally to solve the most complex challenges in the financial services industry, come join our dynamic GDS team!
   

  

**The opportunity**
 We are looking for a Senior to join our Life Insurance Actuarial Practice delivering MG\-ALFA/Integrate user level, testing and modeling solutions to the leading clients in Insurance Sector, working closely with other Staff/Assistants, Consultants/Seniors, Managers, Senior Managers or Client partners in EY’s global network of insurance sector and consulting professionals
   

  

 You can expect to work along with senior managers/directors to support large scale engagements and deliver high\-quality client solutions. You will develop and maintain long\-term relationships and networks, build and energize a high performing team.
   

  

 Our growing team of professionals come from a diverse background, all committed to being long term trusted advisors to our clients.
   

  

**Key Requirements**
* As a Senior within the Life MG\-ALFA/Integrate actuarial team your role involves developing and implementing solutions both within the Insurance service line and in collaboration with other services lines.
* Good understanding of US product lines and regulatory standards; hands\-on valuation or modeling experience in a senior capacity (desirable)
* Experience of handling a small to moderate sized team will be an advantage
* Ability to review work done by junior members, ensuring quality of work product during time sensitive deadlines
* Ability to maneuver around existing modeling setup to incorporate the GAAP or STAT or LDTI / IFRS 17 cashflows
* Understanding of AoC concept and AoC steps (unwinding, roll forward, assumption changes, experience variances)
* Strong excel skills, capable of running and modifying macros used to transform Actuarial Cashflows
* Ability to develop regression models on excel to test the model developments
* Hands\-on or Advance level experience in MG\-ALFA/Integrate actuarial valuation software.
* Strong experience on Excel is must and experience on VBA would be good
* Good experience of preparing PPT decks
* In\-depth understanding of insurance products and regulations of the US, Canada and other geographies
* We are looking for individuals who have a proactive attitude and are seeking the opportunity for personal and professional growth, leveraging and supporting our global network.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
 Skills and attributes for a successful career at EY require a learning mindset and passion to add value to GDS, member firms and client organisations. Bright and enthusiastic individuals who give their all to each assignment they work on will find themselves at home within our energetic GDS actuarial team.
   

  

**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* 3\-6 years of MG\-ALFA/ INTEGRATE modelling experience or valuation / reporting / pricing experience (while working on MG\-ALFA/ INTEGRATE) in life actuarial team of an insurance / consulting / outsourcing company
* Good analytical skills
* Ability to do investigations in models / reporting process and independently solve problems
* Willingness to learn and apply learning actively in project work Proficiency in MS\-Office Suite, Power BI, VBA, SAS, R Programming, Python, SQL, SPSS, etc., will be a plus


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Good actuarial exam progress
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for report writing, industry studies and stakeholder presentations
* The ability to build relationships with colleagues across the business, support them and promote a collaborative environment
* Overseas exposure (especially US/Canada/Europe market experience)


**What We Look For**
* Up to date knowledge of the regulatory environment impacting insurers and other financial service organisations
* Experience of supporting teams to high quality timely delivery, actively building relationships and promoting a collaborative culture when working with colleagues


**What We Offer**
 EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well\-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever\-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
